messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] reserved-pool-usage HIGH for pool dedicated-eu-west
incident-bot: metrics: reserved_gpu_utilization=99.8%, queue_length=1123, autoscaler=\"error: scale-limit-reached\"
ryan-oncall: paging... taking this
maya-eng: seeing a huge queue on dedicated-eu-west-resv. autoscaler hitting max_instances (200). noisy tenant? any customer spikes?
liz-sre: graphs show Tenant: AcmeCorp consuming ~40% of GPU slots; looks like a long-running inference job causing noisy neighbor behavior
sam-platform: autoscaler logs show: \"scale_limit_reached: desired=210, limit=200\" and cloud provider rate limits on create_instances
maya-eng: extracting autoscaler snippet:
```
ERROR: failed_to_scale: cloudapi: RateLimitExceeded
Desired=210, Limit=200
```
ryan-oncall: immediate mitigation options: 1) short-term throttle lower-tier/shared tenants 2) evict idle sessions (>30m) 3) route enterprise-critical traffic to fallback pool in eu-east 4) enable model-fallback to smaller variants
cs-alex: pinging AcmeCorp now (CS) — need to warn about potential throttling / degraded throughput; they have a big morning batch scheduled
acctmanager-jordan: on it, calling Acme eng and cc'ing sales. will request they reduce concurrency if possible
liz-sre: running eviction for idle sessions: `/opt/bin/evict_idle_sessions --pool dedicated-eu-west --idle-minutes 30 --dry-run=false`
deploy-bot: eviction job queued: job-id=evict-171999abcd started
maya-eng: enabling enterprise model-fallback policy: prefer smaller-quantized variants so we can increase concurrency per GPU
sam-platform: changing routing policy: route enterprise-critical traffic to dedicated-eu-east-fallback temporarily (probing latency impact)
ryan-oncall: applying soft-throttle on shared tenants to free ~10% capacity: `rbac-throttle set --pool dedicated-eu-west --tier shared --pct 10`
maya-eng: eviction + throttle freed ~38 GPUs; queue reduced from 1123 -> 420 in ~12m
liz-sre: autoscaler retried and scaled to 198 instances; still below desired. opened cloud quota ticket INC-5234 (provider quota increase)
cs-alex: Acme confirms long-running pipelines; asked them to lower concurrency. they agreed to a temporary 50% reduction
acctmanager-jordan: proposing temporary reserved burst for Acme and offer credits; looping in Sales
ryan-oncall: active mitigations: eviction, soft-throttle, routing to eu-east fallback, model-fallback. monitoring for 30m
incident-bot: Incident update: severity=high, impacted_customers=[\"AcmeCorp\"], mitigation_actions=[eviction, soft-throttle, routing-fallback], ticket=INC-5234
sam-platform: next steps: 1) request emergency cloud quota increase 2) plan reserved capacity bump for Acme 3) postmortem & autoscaler tuning to avoid hard cap failures
maya-eng: I'll own follow-up: run load tests with shorter eviction thresholds and tune pre-scale signals (queue_gradient, per-tenant burst detector)
ryan-oncall: if queue trends up again -> escalate to oncall+eng-sre bridge. for now we watch
cs-alex: Acme reduced load and reported throughput stable; they appreciate the heads-up
liz-sre: final check: reserved_gpu_utilization=85%, queue_length=120, no new scale errors in logs
ryan-oncall: thanks all :thumbsup: turning this into a postmortem draft once stable
deploy-bot: deployment hook applied: autoscaler policy patched (soft) max_instances=260, expires_in=4h, change_id=chg-171999xyz
maya-eng: noted. we'll follow up on hard cap and autoscaler resiliency. good work team
